input.answer: Canada's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate (15 years and over, both genders) fell by 0.6 percentage points between September 2025 and September 2026. It was 7.1% in September 2025 and 6.5% in September 2026. The arithmetic is 6.5 − 7.1 = −0.6.
